subject: Experience replay kickoff: replay-ratio guidance for every RL stack
body:
Team,

Kicking off the experience-replay standardization effort for agents-rl. Our open-source study revisited replay fundamentals - how replay capacity and the ratio of new-to-old experience drive value-based agent performance - and internal teams are still configuring buffers by folklore. We turn the findings into defaults.

Concretely, the released code exposes the levers cleanly: replay_capacity (1M in the reference config) and the replay ratio via oldest_policy_in_buffer (250k default), with the ElephantDQNAgent runner on Atari. Our deliverable is a sweep across those knobs on three internal environments plus Atari references, and a config guide with recommended settings per workload class.

Milestones for Apr 20 - Jun 29: sweep harness running by May 15, full sweep results by Jun 12, published guidance + adoption by two internal RL teams by window close.

Jelena owns staffing and data. Q3 OKR ties to adoption, so end date matters.

Ulla
